newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar started as accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar started as accumulate.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said Monday it was initiating coverage of Argentine steelmaker Acindar as a medium term "accumulate" and long term "buy."

-- "The intermediate term Accumulate rating is based on the stock's steep appreciation of over 90 percent which has resulted in less than compelling valuation relative to Acindar's Latin American peers," Merrill Lynch said in a report.

-- It said the long term buy recommendation was based on the company's position as largest producer of long steel products and the country's good macroeconomic picture, which together should lead to strong earnings growth.
-- The brokers estimated Acindar's domestic market share at 58 percent of the long product sector, which is linked to the construction industry.

-- "As it currently stands, Acindar trades at an 11.3 percent premium to its Latin American counterparts on a price to cash flow basis. It does trade at a discount to the Argentine average, which is composed of three companies, of which the pricy Siderca is one, thereby inflating the average," the report said.
